components.name: Info wrap
components.description: Info wrap — a soft, full-width info strip above a CTA or cart (delivery terms, free-delivery threshold, promo note). Lines=1 for one fact; Lines=2 adds an accent title. Info icon opens details. Not an alert: no status colours, never dismissible.
